changed: When another device runs a newer version of the app and shares records with details this version doesn't know about yet (such as a program's pay), Device Sync now says so in the "update the app on this device" notice, with a count of each kind of record waiting (for example "2 programs, 1 setting"). Previously those records were listed in the general "records were skipped" notice alongside records skipped for unrelated reasons, which told you to check your other devices instead.

added: A record blob whose body carries a field this build does not know throws SyncUnrecognisedFieldException (a FormatException) and is reported as SyncReportCode.newerRecordFields; a known but non-shareable field is still a plain FormatException. Add isKnownWirePath.
